t: Mi vami hammadliqin veim tau beyom hammeunnan
s: Mi vami hammadliqin veim tau beyom hammeunnan ubo k"h seipim: tiqqenu chakamim sheyyihyeh lekol adam ner doleq beshabbat bekol cheder vecheder sheholek sham beshabbat, mishshum shelom bayit, shello yikkashel beetz o beeben. Vechayyab kol adam kesheokel seuddat hallayla leoklah etzel or hanner, shezzeh biklal oneg shabbat hu. Veiqqar mitzvat hadlaqat nerot hu ner zeh sheokel etzlo. Vihe zahir bo laasoto yapeh. Vekol hazzahir bo — zokeh lebanim talmide chakamim, shenneemar "ki ner mitzva vetora or", al yede "ner mitzva" ba or tora. Veyesh mekavvenim laasot b' petilot bener zeh: echad keneged "zakor", veechad keneged "shamor". Ubenerot shel shaava o shel cheleb vekayyotze bahen — madliqin b' nerot. Vikolin gam ken lehosip ulehadliq g' o d', ki yekolin lehosip al dabar hammekuvvan keneged dabar acher, raq shello yipchot. Velaken ishsha sheshshokcha paam achat lehadliq — nohagin shemmadleqet kol yameha g'. Veim shokcha kamma peamim — mosepet bekol paam, kede sheyyihyeh lah hekker vezikkaron shettehe zehira mikkan ulehabba bikbod shabbat velo tabo lide shikcha. Abal im neensa velo hidliqa, kegon shehayeta bebet haasurim vekayyotze bazeh — enah tzerika lehosip keneged zeh. Veyesh nohagin lehadliq leolam z' nerot. Veyesh nohagim lehadliq asara, mittaam hayyadua lahem. Venohagin lehadliq bebet hakkeneset b' nerot shel shaava kerukim, lizkor she"zakor" ve"shamor" bedibbur echad neemru. Veap bebeto tob laasot ken lepi taam zeh. Vegam kede leharbot haora lehiddur mitzva. Veal nerot shel bet hakkeneset en mebarekin, mittaam sheyyitbaer:

Mi sheen lo maot liqnot ner leshabbat — chayyab apillu lechazzer al happetachim bishbil ner zeh. Veen zeh biklal "aseh shabbatteka chol veal titztarek labberiyyot", lepi shezzehu biklal oneg seuddat hallayla, shekkesheokelah belo ner — en lo oneg mimmenna kol kak, useuddat hallayla hi meiqqar seuddot hashshabbat, veenah doma lisudda shelishit shealeha ameru: "aseh shabbatteka chol veal titztarek labberiyyot", kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"b:

Vaapillu mi sheyyesh beyado meat maot vetzarik liqqach bahem maakalim leshabbat velo yihyeh lo bammeh liqnot ner — hare hanner qodem lekol hammaakalim shel shabbat, chutz mippat, shehappat qodemet lener, shehi iqqar mitzvat hasseudda, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"d:

Veim en yado masseget liqnot yayin leqiddush vener leshabbat — ner shabbat qodem. Veap al pi sheqqiddush hayyom hu min hattora, mikkol maqom al hayyayin eno ella middibre soperim, vegam epshar leqaddesh al happat, ulepikak ner shabbat qodem mishshum shelom beto, shemmitztaarin bene beto lesheb bachoshek veleekol. Velaken im yesh lo ner echad leekol etzlo — day bekak, veyiqneh achar kak yayin leqiddush:

Echad haanashim veechad hannashim chayyabim lihyot bebattehem ner daluq beshabbat, ella shehannashim muzharot bo yoter, mippene shemmetzuyot babbayit veoseqot betzorke habbayit. Veod, mippene shehi kobta nero shel olam, lekak natenu lah mitzvat hadlaqat ner shabbat shettetaqqen mah sheqqilqela. Ulepikak ap im yirtzeh habbaal lehadliq beatzmo — haishsha qodemet. Umikkol maqom, tob shehu yitasseq betiqqun happetilot vehannerot, vegam yadliq bishar chadarim sheen ishsha madleqet sham. Venohagin keshehaishsha yoledet — habbaal madliq umebarek bashshabbat harishona, abal bishar hashshabbatot, ap al pi shehi nidda, veken bekol paam keshehi nidda — mebareket beatzmah (ayyen simman p"ch):

Lo yaqdim lemaher lehadliqo beod hayyom gadol, lepi sheaz eno nikkar shemmadliqo likbod shabbat. Vegam lo yeacher. Veim rotzeh lehadliq hanner beod hayyom gadol uleqabbel alayv shabbat beotah shaa samuk lehadlaqa — rashshay, ki kevan shemmeqabbel alayv shabbat lealtar — en zo haqdama, ubilbad sheyyehe mippelag hammincha ulemala, shehu shaa urebia zemanniyyot qodem hallayla (ayyen simman rs"a). Veim hidliq hanner beod hayyom gadol velo qibbel alayv shabbat miyyad — tzarik lekabboto velachazor ulehadliqo letzorek shabbat, kede shettihyeh hahadlaqa atzmah nikkeret shehi likbod hashshabbat. Umikkan sameku haqqadmonim shehayu meshaggerim hattinoq[o]t mibbet hakkeneset lebattehem qodem "bareku" sheyyetzavvu lehadliq az, velo yadliqu qodem mincha, kevan sheenan meqabbelim az alehem et hashshabbat:

Yesh omerim shekkevan shehidliq ner shabbat chal alayv hashshabbat veneesar baasiyyat melaka, ella im ken hitna sheeno meqabbel alayv shabbat behadlaqa zo. Veal pi zeh nohagot hannashim sheachar shebbereku vehidliqu hannerot — mashlikot laaretz happetila shebbeyadan shehidliqu bah hannerot, veenan mekabbot otah, shekkebar chal alehen shabbat bigmar hadlaqa zo. Abal yekolot lehadliq nerot harbeh, shekkullan mitzvat hadlaqa achat hen, veen qabbalat hashshabbat chala ad achar gemar hahadlaqa. Veyesh choleqim al zeh veomerim sheen qabbalat shabbat teluya kelal behadlaqat nerot, ella behatchalat tepillat arbit shel shabbat, shekkevan sheamar hashsheliach tzibbur "bareku" hakkol poreshim mimmelaktam. Veken iqqar (umikkol maqom, ledibre hakkol tzarik sheyyeqabbel shabbat lealtar achar hahadlaqa, kemo shennitbaer lemala). Abal hamminhag hu kassebara harishona, sheotah ishsha hammadleqet meqabbelet shabbat aleha behadlaqa zo, velaken titpallel mincha techilla, abal shear bene habbayit muttarim bimlaka ad "bareku". Vaapillu otah ishsha, im hitnet techilla apillu belibbah sheenah meqabbelet shabbat behadlaqa zo — moil lah tenay zeh bimqom hatztzorek. Abal shello bimqom hatztzorek — en lismok al hattenay, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheen tenay moil kelal lepi daat haomerim sheqqabbalat shabbat teluya behadlaqat ner shabbat. Vekol zeh keshehidliqa hannerot sheal hashshulchan, shehen iqqar hammitzva ubahen teluya qabbalat hashshabbat, abal shear hannerot shemmadleqet babbayit ubishar chadarim — en qabbalat shabbat teluya bahen ledibre hakkol, umuttar lah laasot acharehen kol hammelakot ad shettadliq nerot sheal hashshulchan. Vekol zeh beishsha, abal beish hammadliq en bo shum minhag kelal, umaamidin al iqqar haddin sheen qabbalat shabbat teluya behadlaqat nerot ella baamirat "bareku". Umikkol maqom, tob lehatnot lekattechilla:

Hammadliq ner shel shabbat veyom tob, echad haish veechad haishsha — chayyabim lebarek ober laasiyyatan "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv, vetzivvanu lehadliq ner shel shabbat", o "shel yom tob", kederek shemmebarekim al shear kol mitzvot middibre soperim ober laasiyyatan. Vehamminhag shemmebarekim achar hahadlaqa, lepi shessoberin sheim tebarek techilla qibbela leshabbat, utehe asura lehadliq. Veap beyom tob madliqin techilla, kede shello lechalleq bibraka achat lebarek otah peamim qodem hadlaqa upeamim achar kak. Ukede shettehe habberaka ober laasiyya — enah nehenet min haor ad achar habberaka, dehaynu shemmesima yadah lipne hanner miyyad achar hahadlaqa ad achar gemar habberaka, veaz mesira yadah venehenet min haor, vezeh niqra ober laasiyya:

Bachurim haholekim lilmod chutz lebetam — tzerikim lehadliq ner shabbat bechadram ulebarek alayv ap al pi sheenam okelim sham, lepi shehadlaqat ner beshabbat choba ap belo akila, kede shello yikkashel beetz vaeben, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal mi shehu etzel ishto umadliq bekol hachadarim sheholek sham beshabbat kemo shennitbaer lemala — eno tzarik lebarek alehem, lepi sheishto mebareket bishbilo bebet akila. Abal kesheeno etzel ishto — eno niptar bebirkat ishto kesheyyesh lo cheder meyuchad sham bemaqom shemmitareach. Veim en lo cheder meyuchad sham (vaapillu im yesh lo ella shebbaal habbayit mishtammesh sham gam ken, vetzarik habbaal habbayit lehadliq sham ner shello) — en haoreach tzarik lehadliq sham kelal, kevan sheyyesh lo shelom bayit bemaqom shehu sham, vegam mitzvat hadlaqat ner shabbat hu meqayyem bemah shemmadliqim ner shabbat bebeto (mishshello). Abal im en lo mi sheyyadliq bebeto (o apillu im madliqim sham ella sheenan madliqim mishshello — eno niptar behadlaqatam, ap im hu beinyan shekkeshehaya etzlam niptar behadlaqatam, kegon shessamuk al shulchanam, shennaaseh mikkelal bene betam veniptar banner shellahem, mikkol maqom akshav sheeno etzlam — eno niptar beneram, ella) tzarik hu leqayyem mitzvat hadlaqat ner shabbat bemaqom shehu, al yede sheyyitten peruta lebaal habbayit lehishtattep immo banner shello, o sheyyaqneh lo baal habbayit cheleq banner shello bemattana, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tra"z leinyan ner chanukka. (Bameh debarim amurim? Kesheokel sham mishshello, abal im hu samuk al shulchan baal habbayit — naaseh kibne beto shel baal habbayit veyotze benero shel baal habbayit, veeno tzarik lehishtattep immo kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer sham). Vekol zeh kesheen lo cheder meyuchad sham:

B' o g' baale battim sheokelin al shulchan echad umebarekim kol echad al menora shello — yesh mepaqpeqin lomar sheyyesh kan beraka lebattala, lepi shekkebar yesh sham ora merubba minnerot shehidliq harishon. Veyesh meyashshebin hamminhag, shekkol mah shenittosepa ora babbayit — yesh bah shelom bayit vesimcha yetera lahanaat ora bekol zavit. Umikkol maqom, apillu lepi datam lo yebareku shenayim bimnora achat sheyyesh lah qanim harbeh. Uledibre hakkol, yakol hashsheni lebarek becheder hammeyuchad lo, ap al pi sheeno okel sham veeno mishtammesh sham shum tzorek akila, mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu becheder hammeyuchad larishon, im harishon mishtammesh shum tzorke akila beoto cheder vaadayin lo haya sham — yakol hashsheni lehadliq sham mishshello, o mimmah sheyyaqneh lo harishon, ulebarek al hadlaqa zo, ap al pi shehu lo yishtammesh kelum etzel nerotayv:

Ulepikak nohagot miqtzat hannashim belel tebila shehen tzerikot lachapop roshan vegupan bechammin mibbeod yom bebet hammerchatz etzel hammiqveh, vei epshar lahen lehadliq hannerot qodem lektan lesham, lepi shehen meqabbelot hashshabbat al yede hadlaqat hannerot kemo shennitbaer, vaasurot lirchotz bechammin achar kak, veenan rotzot lelek ben chapipa litbila lebetan lehadliq nerot shemmityorot shello yetannepem belektan utehe bahem chatzitza, laken madliqin nerot shellahen ben chapipa litbila bebet hakkeneset shel nashim im hu samuk lebet hattebila, vehashshamash mishtammesh sham shum dabar mitztzorke akila leor neroteha, vekol shekken im hi atzmah yekola lehishtammesh sham shum dabar shettehaneh bo ballayla letzorek akila. Abal enah yekola lehadliq ulebarek al nerot hammeyuchadim lebet hakkeneset shedderek lehadliqan sham bekol shabbat, apillu im tirtzeh lehishtammesh tzorke akila leoran, lepi shennerot hallalu enan asuyim lehair ulehishtammesh leoran, ella lekabod bilbad. Umikkol maqom, yoter tob shebbelel tebila yadliq habbaal vibarek. (O telek ben chapipa litbila lebetah lehadliq sham, vekol shekken im epshar shettachop bebetah shezzeh yoter tob. Veim i epshar bekol elleh — tadliq utebarek qodem lektah lebet hattebila vetatneh sheenah meqabbelet shabbat behadlaqa zo, shettenay zeh moil bimqom hatztzorek kemo shennitbaer). Veken taaseh kesheyyesh chuppa beereb shabbat utzerika lelek lesham vetitacher sham ad achar sheqiat hachamma, vei epshar lah shetteqabbel shabbat qodem lektah lesham — (azay tadliq utebarek vetatneh sheenah meqabbelet shabbat behadlaqa zo. Umikkol maqom, en lah lehatnot tenay zeh ella im ken habbaal yeqabbel alayv shabbat miyyad samuk lehadlaqatah, dekevan shehi enah meqabbelet lealtar leachar hadlaqatah, shetztzerika lishhot harbeh bachapipatah o belektah lechuppa, im ken im gam habbaal lo yeqabbel lealtar — yitztarek lekabbot hanner velachazor ulehadliqo samuk leqabbalat shabbat kemo shennitbaer lemala venimtza shebbereka lebattala). Abal en lah lehadliq lekattechilla qodem lektah belo beraka, ubeboah mehattebila mishshechasheka o mehachuppa tipros yadeha lipne hannerot ulebarek az qodem shettehaneh leoran, veken im datah labo mehachuppa beben hashshemashot — en lah lismok al zeh shello lehadliq qodem lektah veshettetzavveh lenokri lehadliq keshettabo beben hashshemashot veshettebarek hi al yede perisat yadeha miyyad achar hadlaqat hannokri, shello tehaneh leoran ad achar birkatah, lepi shehaek tebarek "vetzivvanu lehadliq" vehen doleqot kebar miqqodem leken, o al yede hannokri. Umikkol maqom, bediabad sheshshokcha velo hidliqa qodem ben hashshemashot venizkera beben hashshemashot — yesh lehattir lah letzavvot lenokri lehadliq veshettebarek hi qodem shettehaneh leoran (dekevan sheiqqar mitzvat hadlaqat ner shabbat enah hahadlaqa bilbad, ella hahanaa vehattashmish leorah hi iqqar hammitzva, ella shehahadlaqa hi hatchala vahakana lemitzva zo, velaken mebarekim aleha, vezo sheshshokcha velo bereka bitchillat hammitzva — yekola lebarek qodem iqqar hammitzva, dehaynu qodem shettehaneh leoran). Umikkol maqom, lo tetzavveh lehadliq ella ner echad al hashshulchan, shezzehu iqqar hammitzva. (Abal ner echad epshar lehattir lah ap im yesh sham kebar ner daluq, shemmeachar shehannashim nizharot meod bibraka zo — hare zeh ketzorek gadol shehittiru bo shebut beben hashshemashot, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"a):

Suma yekola gam ken lebarek al ner shabbat, shehare hi nehenet gam ken mimmeorot, kemo shennitbaer besimman s"t. Umikkol maqom, im yesh lah baal piqqeach — yebarek habbaal. Ak im okelet beshulchan echad im acherim shebbereku vehidliqu — en lah lebarek, shehare az en mitzva behadlaqa zo ella mishshum simcha yetera kemo shennitbaer lemala, velah en simcha kelal meor hanner:

Mitzva laasot lekattechilla nerot arukkim sheyyadliqu ad hallayla. Umikkol maqom, im asa nerot qetannim sheenan doleqim ad hallayla — en kan beraka lebattala, shekkevan sheakal leoran venehena mehen bisuddat shabbat. Abal im lo akal leoran, kegon sheakal bechatzer, veal derek sheyyitbaer besimman ra"g, im enan doleqot ad hallayla, sheaz hu neheneh mehen bachazarato labbayit shello yikkashel beetz vaeben beishon apela velayla — hare berak lebattala. Umikkol maqom, im hu beinyan shehaya sham qetzat choshek beezeh maqom samuk lachasheka im lo hayu doleqot sham vehishtammesh sham beoto maqom shum dabar leoran — en bezeh issur:

Im hidliq ner bemaqom sheen mishtammeshin bo kelum beshabbat sheeno chayyab lehadliq sham ner, veachar kak natal ner zeh haddaluq vehinnicho bemaqom shemmishtammeshim bo — lo yatza yede chobato bener zeh, dekevan shebbeshaa shehidliqo haya bemaqom sheen mishtammeshim bo beshabbat — eno nikkar shehudlaq likbod hashshabbat. Veim berak al hadlaqato — hare zo beraka lebattala. Abal yakol lebarek ulehadliq bemaqom shemmishtammeshin bo beshabbat, ap al pi sheen mishtammeshim sham tzorke akila, im hu cheder shello, o shehu meyuchad lo, ben sheyyannichennu doleq sham, ben sheyyannichennu achar kak apillu bemaqom sheen mishtammeshim bo kelum beshabbat, veyadliq kan ner acher, dekevan shehanner shebberak alayv haya munnach shaa muetet kan bemaqom hachayyab bener shabbat — en kan beraka lebattala. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yesh lizzaher lebarek al otan hannerot shehen kebar al hashshulchan, velo al shear hannerot apillu otan shebbetok habbayit, vaapillu rotzeh lehannichan achar kak al hashshulchan, lepi sheiqqar hammitzva hen hannerot sheal hashshulchan sheokelin leoran, verauy shettehe habberaka al otan hammunnachim bemaqom shehu iqqar hammitzva. Umikkol maqom, day sham bener echad (o b' nerot keneged "zakor" ve"shamor"). Abal im yesh nashim rabbot bebayit echad — yekolot lebarek lekattechilla gam bishar meqomot, ubilbad sheyyehe maqom shemmishtammeshim bo beshabbat, ap al pi sheen mishtammeshim bo tzorke akila, im hu cheder hammeyuchad lah o lebalah. Veim eno meyuchad lah — enah yekola lehadliq sham ella im ken mishtammeshim sham tzorke akila, ap al pi shehem en mishtammeshim sham kelum, ella baal habbayit ubene beto, o apillu acherim, mishtammeshim sham tzorke akila:

(Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheokelet mishshellah, abal im hi semuka al shulchan baal habbayit — enah yekola lebarek sham, ella im ken hacheder meyuchad lah o lebalah, sheim lo ken enah chayyebet kelal lehadliq sham, sheen chiyyub ner shabbat chal aleha kelal, lepi shehi biklal bene beto shel baal habbayit venipteret benero. Veap im baal habbayit metzavveh lah lehadliq veoseh otah shaliach lepotro mechiyyubo shehu chayyab lehadliq sham, lepi shemmishtammesh sham beshabbat, apillu mishtammesh sham tzorke akila, vaapillu im hu o miqtzat bene beto okelim sham, mikkol maqom kevan shehu o ishto bereku bemaqom echad veniptar bibraka zo lekol hachadarim shechayyab lehadliq sham kemo shennitbaer lemala — im ken gam shelucho eno yakol lebarek sham. Veyesh choleqim al zeh. Veken nitpashshet hamminhag bimdinot ellu):

Ap al pi shello hitpalelu haqqahal adayin, im qadam hayyachid vehitpallel arbit shel shabbat mibbeod yom — chal alayv qabbalat hashshabbat, veasur baasiyyat melaka. Apillu im omer beperush sheeno rotzeh leqabbel adayin — en zeh moil kelum, kevan shehizkir kebar inyano shel yom battepilla:

Im rob haqqahal qibbelu alehem shabbat — hammiut nimshakim acharehem beal korcham vaasurim bimlaka, ap al pi shello hayu bebet hakkeneset etzel qabbalat shabbat, vaapillu omerim beperush sheenam rotzim leqabbel shabbat adayin:
Veim era sheechad lo tiqqen adayin maakalo leshabbat keshehatztzibbur rotzim lomar "bareku" — yesh lahem lehamtin alayv (mimmiddat chasidut). Veim hu samuk leben hashshemashot — al yamtinu:

Abal im rob haqqahal lo hayu bebet hakkeneset — enam nimshakim achar hammiut. Veir sheyyesh bah batte kenesiot harbeh — en haqqahal hammitpalelin beechad mehem nimshakim achar hammitpalelim baacherim, ap al pi shehemma hammiut neged haacherim. (Veyachid shello haya bebet hakkeneset sheqqibbelu bah shabbat, ap al pi shehu ragil lehitpallel tamid beoto bet hakkeneset, im rob hair lo qibbelu adayin shabbat — epshar lehattiro bimlaka):

Adam shebba lair ukebar qibbelu anshe hair shabbat alehem, ap al pi sheadayin hayyom gadol — chal alayv hashshabbat gam ken. Veim haya alayv shum chepetz muqtzeh o maot — lo yetaltelennu beyadayv lahasiro mimmennu, ella yaaseh kemo she[yi]tebbaer besimman rs"v bemi sheshshakach kiso alayv beshabbat, veayyen sham:

Mi shettaa beyom hammeunnan vesober shehu chasheka mammash vehitpallel arbit shel shabbat veachar kak noda lo sheod hayyom gadol, ap al pi shekkeshehitpallel haya mippelag hammincha ulemala shehu zeman harauy letosepet shabbat — tzarik hu lachazor ulehitpallel arbit, kevan shehu lo nitkavven bitpillato mippene qabbalat tosepet shabbat, ella mippene shehu layla, vahare hitpallel betaut, umuttar lo laasot melaka qodem qabbalat shabbat bitpilla hashsheniyya, lepi sheqqabbala harishona hayeta betaut veenah chashuba kelum:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Biychidim, abal tzibbur shettau beyom hammeunnan vehitpalelu arbit shel shabbat beod hayyom gadol — enam tzerikim lachazor ulehitpallel im keshehitpalelu haya mippelag hammincha ulemala, lepi sheen matrichin al hatztzibbur. Vekevan sheenam tzerikim lachazor ulehitpallel — chal alehem qabbalat hashshabbat shebbattepilla harishona, vaasurim bimlaka. Umikkol maqom, im yesh miut shello qibbelu adayin shabbat — enan nimshakim achar harob, kevan sheqqabbalat harob hayeta betaut. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, sheap im kol hatztzibbur qibbelu betaut — muttarim kullam bimlaka ap al pi sheenam tzerikim lachazor ulehitpallel, lepi sheen matrichin alehem, abal qabbalatam enah kelum, kevan shehi betaut. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem im tzerikim lekak:

Mi sheshshaha lehitpallel mincha beereb shabbat ad sheqqibbelu haqqahal shabbat, dehaynu sheameru "bareku" — lo yitpallel mincha beotah bet hakkeneset beshaa shehaqqahal mitpalelin arbit, shemmeachar shehaqqahal qiddeshu hayyom — en lo laasoto chol etzlam, ella yelek chutz lebet hakkeneset veyitpallel sham mincha shel chol. Vehu shello ana immahem achar "bareku", abal im ana — hare qibbel alayv shabbat veasur lo lehitpallel mincha shel chol, ella yitpallel arbit shettayim, kedin taa velo hitpallel mincha beereb shabbat shennitbaer besimman q"ch:

Veim ba lebet hakkeneset samuk le"bareku" — yatchil lehitpallel mincha shel chol. Veap al pi shemmiyyad beodo mitpallel mincha yomru hatztzibbur "bareku" viqabbelu shabbat — en lo lachush bemah shehu mitpallel etzlam tepilla shel chol, kevan shehitchil behetter. Veap al pi shekkol dabar shetztzarik lehatchil behetter tzarik lehaqdim kol kak beinyan sheyyukal ligmor qodem shettaggia sheat haissur, abal im yadua sheyyimshok tok sheat haissur — hare zeh kematchil beissur, kemo shennitbaer besimman rl"h, mikkol maqom kan en lehaqpid kol kak, lepi sheissur zeh shello lehitpallel tepilla shel chol etzel tzibbur hammitpallel shel shabbat — eno ella chumra beolma:

Mi sheqqadam lehitpallel arbit shel shabbat qodem shehitpalelu haqqahal, ap al pi shekkebar chal alayv qabbalat shabbat — yakol lomar apillu leyisrael chabero shello qibbel adayin hashshabbat sheyyaaseh lo melaka, umuttar lo lehanot mehammelaka beshabbat, dekevan shellachabero muttar hu — en baamirato elayv issur kelal (velo aseru haamira lenokri ap al pi sheeno metzuvveh al hashshabbat), ella kesheomer lo beshaa haasura lekol yisrael (ayyen simman rs"a). Veken mi shemmeacher lehitpallel arbit bemotzae shabbat, o shemmamshik seuddato ballayla — muttar lo lomar apillu leyisrael shekkebar hitpallel vehibdil battepilla sheyyaaseh lo melaka, umuttar lo lehanot veleekol mimmelakto, ap al pi sheachar kak yazkir adayin shel shabbat bebirkat hammazon:
